personality_one_liner: A high-clarity, friction-free vault that frames colorful e-commerce data within a crisp, neutral iOS-native structure.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. iOS-native rhythms. Do not cramp elements.

do's: Use on sticky header over scrolling list
Use on filter chip row background when scrolling under
dont's: Do not use on individual order cards
Do not use on form inputs

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard to view stats and track orders.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty cardboard box + 'No orders logged yet. Start tracking!' + Primary CTA to Add Order.

screens.layout: Sticky Header with Search Bar. Below it, a single horizontal scrolling filter chip row (56pt height row, 36pt height chips, no wrapping). Below filters: a horizontal pager or 2-column grid of Summary Cards (Total spent, In transit, Return eligible). Below that: Vertical list of order cards. Each order card MUST display the platform color as a visual accent (e.g., left border strip or tinted logo background), product name, order status badge, and 'X days left' return badge if applicable.

screens.name: Add Order
screens.purpose: Frictionless form to manually enter or OCR an order.
screens.layout: Top banner for OCR: 'Paste screenshot to auto-fill' using Gemini. Below, horizontal grid/row of platform selector circles utilizing the custom `platform_colors`. Form fields (Product name, Price, Expected delivery, Return deadline) follow in a single column with labels above inputs. Sticky 'Save Order' CTA button at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Order Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of an order with its delivery timeline and return tracking.
screens.layout: Product info hero at the top with Platform logo/color context. A highly visible 'X days left for return' badge prominently positioned (using 'warning' or 'error' tokens depending on urgency). Below, a vertical Status Timeline Stepper (Ordered -> Shipped -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered -> Returned/Exchanged). Include a 'Notes' section at the bottom.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Visual insights on user's spending habits.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'Add orders to see your spending insights'

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top section: Bar chart showing monthly spend grouped by platform (using react-native-gifted-charts, bars color-coded by platform). Middle section: Pie chart showing spend by category. Bottom section: summary statistics.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Standard iOS-native grouped list view. Include options for Dark Mode toggle and 'Export to CSV' button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the 'Plus Jakarta Sans' font family and neutral brand colors (black/white) to ensure the vibrant platform colors (Amazon orange, Myntra pink, etc.) pop effectively.
Implement the Filter Chip Row exactly as specified: single horizontal ScrollView, no flexWrap, 36pt height for individual chips, inside a 56pt height container.
For the Analytics screen, use `react-native-gifted-charts` as requested by the user, applying the `platform_colors` object to style the bars/pie slices according to the e-commerce brand.
The Return deadline badge must explicitly calculate and display 'X days left'. Use the 'warning' color token if <= 3 days, and 'success' or default neutral if plenty of time remains.
Ensure the Status Timeline Stepper in the Order Detail view is vertical and clearly marks completed vs. pending steps.
When fetching platform logos isn't possible natively, fall back to Initials Avatar (e.g. 'A' for Amazon) but MUST use the specified `platform_colors` as the background for those avatars.
Ensure dark mode is fully mapped out. The 'surface' in dark mode is true black (#000000) and 'surfaceSecondary' is #1C1C1E, avoiding any purple/indigo hues entirely.
